schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (TEMP.MIN_DATE + 1) = A.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT TEMP.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS FRACTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS MIN_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS TEMP JOIN ACTIVITY AS A ON TEMP.PLAYER_ID = A.PLAYER_ID
q2: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) EVENT_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) SELECT ROUND(COUNT(C.PLAYER_ID) / COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID), 2) AS FRACTION FROM ACTIVITY A1 LEFT JOIN CTE C ON C.PLAYER_ID = A1.PLAYER_ID AND DATEDIFF(A1.EVENT_DATE, C.EVENT_DATE) = 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (TEMP.MIN_DATE + 1) = A.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT TEMP.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS FRACTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS MIN_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS TEMP JOIN ACTIVITY AS A ON TEMP.PLAYER_ID = A.PLAYER_ID
q2_prompt_sql: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) EVENT_DATE FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) SELECT ROUND(COUNT(C.PLAYER_ID) / COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID), 2) AS FRACTION FROM ACTIVITY A1 LEFT JOIN CTE C ON C.PLAYER_ID = A1.PLAYER_ID AND DATEDIFF(A1.EVENT_DATE, C.EVENT_DATE) = 1
counterexample: INSERT INTO ACTIVITY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE, DEVICE_ID, GAMES_PLAYED) VALUES (1, '2023-01-01', 101, 5), (1, '2023-01-02', 102, 3);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 calculates the fraction of players who have an event on the day immediately following their first event, while Q2 calculates the fraction of players who have an event on the day immediately following any of their events.
counterexample_dsp: A player with two events, where the second event is on the day immediately following the first event.
